exposure: postdates induction of labor with oxytocin under midwifery care
cohort: low-risk Ontario midwifery clients who had postdates oxytocin induction
finding: For low-risk midwifery clients at 41 weeks or more gestation, induction of labor with oxytocin under midwifery care had similar odds of Cesarean section and neonatal morbidity and mortality compared to induction under obstetrical care, but decreased rates of intervention.
